messages:
Ann P.: Heads up — OrchidAI sent an export-notice + a marketplace redistribution clause. Need a quick read: can we list them in cloud marketplaces and bundle with HW partners? Ping legal + eng. TL;DR attached (see excerpt below).
Maria G.: Can someone paste the clause? want to see if it says 'no public redistribution' vs 'redistribution allowed with attribution'.
Jay (Legal): Pasted excerpt from their clause:
```
Section 4.2 Redistribution: 'Allowed for internal use and commercial redistribution to third-parties subject to attribution; explicit prohibition on sublicensing binary-only distributions without source.'
Section 7 Export: 'Recipient is responsible for export compliance; weights originating from restricted jurisdictions may require a license.'
```
Jay (Legal): Quick take — pre-installation on partner HW = redistribution, so we need explicit permission. Also need export-classification (ECCN). I'll loop in export team.
Ashwin K.: From runtime perspective — if clause forbids binary-only sublicensing we can't ship prepackaged quantized binaries. Options: host weights ourselves (if license allows) or provide marketplace bundle that links to upstream download + verification script (BYOW flow).
Sophie L.: Marketplace product asks for a redistribution checkbox and source/owner fields. If we can't rehost, we should surface a 'hosted by partner' vs 'bring your own weights (BYOW)' flow in the SKU UI.
Liam R.: SteelEdge (HW partner) wants to sell devices with weights pre-installed. That would be redistribution. Jay — can we get a carve-out or am I assuming correctly that we'd need explicit wording?
Jay (Legal): Correct — pre-installation = redistribution. Need explicit written permission. Also need the partner to provide a copy of the original license and to confirm export origin. I'll open a ticket with exports and draft an addendum.
Ann P.: Action list: Jay to confirm redistribution permission + export classification by EOD; Ashwin to draft a marketplace BYOW UI option; Sophie to update product checklist and SKU fields; Maria to sync with OrchidAI contact (Meera). Also add a quick safety eval before listing (toxicity/sensitive categories).
Maria G.: :thumbsup: I'll reach out. OrchidAI contact: meera@orchidai.ai — will ask for a signed redistribution clause and ECCN info.
Ashwin K.: Draft example of a lightweight manifest we can require if we do BYOW:
```
model_manifest:
  name: "OrchidAI-XXL"
  source_url: "https://downloads.orchidai.ai/orchidai-xxl-v1.tar.gz"
  weights_hash: "sha256:abcdef..."
  distribution: "BYOW | Hosted"
  license_reference: "https://orchidai.ai/license-v1"
  preinstall_allowed: "yes | no"
```
Ashwin K.: Implementing BYOW means our marketplace package contains an installer that fetches hash-verified weights at install time, avoiding binary redistribution.
Jay (Legal): Good; also recommend adding a partner MSA addendum with explicit 'pre-install' permission and an indemnity clause for export violations. I'll draft language and share.
Sophie L.: I'll add UI toggles: 'Allow Redwood to host weights', 'Allow pre-installation on partner devices', 'Export classification provided'. That way sku creation blocks until legal says OK.
legal-bot: New ticket created: EXP-4521 (OrchidAI export review)
Ann P.: Thanks all. If Jay needs any sample language or the partner is willing to sign a short addendum, ping me and I'll push it through partner negotiations.
Maria G.: Will update once Meera confirms. Keeping this thread as the single source for the checklist.
